edit.description: the new-blocker gate, reading the queue at the base and at the gated commit, and its place in the producer-only arm
the gate's refusal and its already-standing arm

summary: a `blockedBy` tag a producer's commit adds must name an entry the queue carries at that commit; an edge already standing is never judged again
acceptance: a plan commit that writes a `blockedBy` tag no entry of its own queue carries is refused naming the tag and the entry that declared it, while an edge the base already held passes however it resolves, and a build commit is never judged at all
tests: a producer's commit adding a blockedBy tag no queue entry carries is refused
the refusal names the entry that declared the edge and the tag it named
pins: a blockedBy edge already standing at the base is not judged again
a blockedBy tag naming an entry the commit's own queue carries is accepted
notes: Nothing on the tree judges this: a dangling blocker reads as landed by design (`spec/pending.md`, *Pickability*), which is why only the commit that writes the edge can be told. The base-and-commit read the slice-state gate already makes is the shape; `atCommit` is the reader. Producer-only, so it rides the same arm as the goal-rank gate — the seam it shares with THE-PER-GATE-JUDGES-THE-PRODUCERS-ALONE.
